description: This PHP source file defines a trait called InstallerCommandHelperTrait within the OrangeHRM installer command namespace. It provides utility methods to facilitate interactive command-line installers, including input validation, system check display, and password validation for the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getRequiredField
methods.description: Prompts the user with a label to enter a required input, with optional validation.

methods.name: requiredValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input answer is not null or empty; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: databasePortValidator
methods.description: Validates that the port number is a numeric value between 0 and 65535.

methods.name: alphanumericValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: emailValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input matches a standard email regex.

methods.name: phoneNumberValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input contains only valid characters for phone numbers.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks whether a specific command-line option has been provided.

methods.name: drawSystemCheckTable
methods.description: Displays a system check report in a table format, color-coded based on status.

methods.name: startSection
methods.description: Initiates a console output section with a step title.

methods.name: startStep
methods.description: Updates the console section with the current step.

methods.name: completeStep
methods.description: Marks a step as completed in the console output.

methods.name: validateStrLength
methods.description: Checks if a string's length is within the specified maximum.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Checks the strength of a password and its adherence to policies, throws an exception if invalid.
